Algorithm 1 Go-Explore-based Algorithms
1: procedure GO-EXPLORE-FAMILY(\(s_0\), \(n_{iter}\))
2:    \(\mathcal{A} \leftarrow \{(s_0, 0)\}\)    ▷ Archive of (state, score)
3:    \(\mathcal{T} \leftarrow \emptyset\)    ▷ Collected trajectories
4:    \(\mathcal{F} \leftarrow \emptyset\)    ▷ Trajectory Frontier
5:    for i = 1 to \(n_{iter}\) do
    — Go Phase (State Selection) —
6:    Go-Explore: \(s_{next} \sim h(\mathcal{A})\)    ▷ Hand-crafted heuristic (e.g., visit count, domain score)
7:    XTX: \(s_{next} \leftarrow\) ImitationLearning(\(\mathcal{T}\))    ▷ Imitation learning
8:    IGE: \(s_{next} \leftarrow\) LLM.SelectPromising(\(\mathcal{A}\))    ▷ Ill-defined promising-ness
9:    GLoW: \(W_{global} \leftarrow g_{LLM}(\mathcal{F})\)    ▷ Principled value decomposition (Sec. 3.1)
10:    \(s_{next} \leftarrow\) align\(_{LLM}(\mathcal{A}, W_{global})\)
11:
    — Explore Phase —
12:    Go-Explore: \(\tau \leftarrow\) RandomActions(\(s_{next}\))    ▷ No learning
13:    XTX: \(\tau \leftarrow\) DQN(\(s_{next}\))    ▷ DQN with curiosity reward
14:    IGE: \(\tau \leftarrow\) ReAct(\(s_{next}\))    ▷ Standard LLM agent
15:    GLoW:
16:    for j = 1 to n do    ▷ LLM agent with advantage-driven exploration (Sec. 3.2)
17:    \(\tau_j \leftarrow \pi_{explore}(s_{next}, W_{local}, \{\tau_1, \ldots, \tau_{j-1}\}, \mathcal{F})\)
18:    \(W_{local} \leftarrow\) MAR(\(\{\tau_1, \ldots, \tau_j\}, \mathcal{F}\))
19:    end for
20:    \(\mathcal{T} \leftarrow \mathcal{T} \cup \{\tau_1, \ldots, \tau_n\}\)    ▷ Collect trajectories
21:    \(\mathcal{F} \leftarrow\) top-k(\(\mathcal{F} \cup \{\tau_1, \ldots, \tau_n\}, v\))    ▷ Update trajectory frontier
22:
    — Archive Update —
23:    for each state \(s'\) in \(\tau\) do
24:    if IsNotRedundant(\(s', \mathcal{A}\)) then    ▷ Domain-specific novelty
25:    \(\mathcal{A} \leftarrow \mathcal{A} \cup \{s'\}\)
26:    end if
27:    end for
28: end for
29: end procedure

Algorithm 3 Exploration with MAR
Require: Selected state \(s_{next}\), Frontier \(\mathcal{F}\), Exploration count \(n\)
Ensure: Trajectory set \(\mathcal{T}_{s}\)
1: \(\mathcal{T}_{s} \leftarrow \emptyset\)
2: \(W_{local} \leftarrow \emptyset\)
3: for \(i = 1\) to \(n\) do
4: \(\tau_{i} \leftarrow \pi_{explore}(s_{next}, W_{local}, \mathcal{T}_{s}, \mathcal{F})\)
5: \(\mathcal{T}_{s} \leftarrow \mathcal{T}_{s} \cup \{\tau_{i}\}\)
6: \(W_{local} \leftarrow MAR(\mathcal{T}_{s}, \mathcal{F})\)
where \(W_{local} = \{(s_{1}^{*}, A_{s_{1}^{*}}), ..., (s_{k}^{*}, A_{s_{k}^{*}})\}\)
7: end for
8: return \(\mathcal{T}_{s}\)
